$comment: A release, not a refusal of an open offer, contract 1.11.0 (ADR 0029 sec 2). Because the claim already happened at poll time, this returns the run to `queued` **without spending an attempt**: the runner may simply have filled up between polling and being handed the work. Central keeps a short in-memory cooldown so the same runner does not pick it straight back up.

reason.$comment: A closed vocabulary rather than free text: this feeds M-AR-4 (why declines happen), and a free-text field would make that measurement unanswerable.
